contract: GetDialogueEntry(rootNodeTitle) returns the root; absent root returns without arcs, present root with zero outgoing links throws prefix+dialogue.dbName. Caller argument windows bind PRIMARY/SECONDARY/IDLE/NAMED to their corresponding actual lists. Each outgoing root link allocates an Arc. NAMED first stores the immediate child Title as customName, then takes that child first outgoing destination as the arc first node; other roots use their linked child directly. PRIMARY plus hasPlayerInitiatedQuestion checks types200/400 (other type logs the pre-existing precise diagnostic at00f0, retained unchanged). First ActorID equals actorsByPluginDbName[player].pluginDbActor.id, or a lowercase Sequence containing none leads to its first successor with that actor ID. Store playerInitiatedQuestion and pluginDbFirstPlayerQuestionDialogueEntry, otherwise throw. AssignedField(first.fields,TfolUniqueDataKeySuffix) must exist and its value must not be whitespace. Missing/blank throws wording+first.DialogueText+space+dialogue.dbName. Compute generatedName=dbName+_+suffix and generatedSavekey=savekey+_+suffix. By actual arcSublist object identity, primary/secondary/idle/named check ^[p][0-9]* / ^[s][0-9]* / ^[i][0-9]* / ^[n][0-9]*, then compare generatedName against every existing arc in that same list. Regexes have no end anchor and permit zero digits; do not strengthen them or treat the whole suffix as numeric. Convention/duplicate errors throw their own prefix+first.DialogueText+space+dialogue.dbName. Store generatedName, pluginDbSuffix, generatedSavekey, dialogue, skip flag from arcSuffixesDisallowSkip.Contains(suffix), and pluginDbFirstDialogueEntry. RecursivelyPopulateDialogueEntries uses a visited-node list and follows only links whose destinationConversationID equals the current conversationID. Then append to dialogue.arcs, Add(suffix,arc) to arcsByDbArcSuffix, Add(generatedSavekey,arc) to arcsBySavekey, append manifest.arcs and finally arcSublist. Within-list checks do not prove global uniqueness; dictionary Add may reject an existing key after earlier mutation. No rollback or runtime validation is claimed. Exception construction/throw is proved; managed/native propagation and actual presentation remain open. Prior eight precise literal roles are retained unchanged.
